review_basis: Existing Blender sources, GLBs, registry metadata, module thumbnails, and the b09db1c contact sheet.
dominant_baseline_findings: Flat façades had little recess depth, trim hierarchy, or roof silhouette.
Repeated single-color cubes made unrelated locations feel generated from one formula.
Interior modules lacked recurring focal props, human-scale clutter, and camera layers.
Street modules proved topology but did not read as inhabited curb-to-storefront places.
The module-tour layout read as a showroom rather than one continuous neighborhood.
decision: Retain all 29 module IDs and semantic metadata. Upgrade five candidates in place, classify the remainder honestly, and add one connected hero master rather than increase shallow module count.
